verdict.rationale: Community evidence indicates a tiered privacy policy where free-tier code may be used for training while Enterprise-tier data is not used beyond immediate processing, implying paying/enterprise users can effectively opt out of data usage — but there is no explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out control or documentation for individual users. missing for 10: explicit telemetry opt-out toggle/setting, first-party privacy documentation confirming opt-out mechanics, independent confirmation beyond a single HN comment.
